summary: Yatra Online, Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The release discusses operational performance, including gross bookings growth of 16.3%, a 10.4% decline in revenue, and geopolitical impacts on travel. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine earnings report incorporated by reference into existing registration statements.
